title: Ruleset hardening: promote 5 rules from Warning to Error
summary: Five analyzer rules (AL0547, AL0679, AW0014, AS0058, PTE0007) were promoted back to Error by removing their overrides from the base ruleset. Violations were fixed by adding a missing codeunit to a permission set and unhiding an action group, or suppressed with documented pragmas.
key_points: Promotes AL0547, AL0679, AW0014, AS0058 and PTE0007 to Error; override count drops from 100 to 95
Adds the Email Logging Install codeunit to the Email Logging - Obj. permission set
Removes Visible = false from the F&unctions group on the ES Account Schedule Names page so the promoted export action is reachable
Suppresses AL0547 on published events and AS0058/PTE0007 on asserterror in test library codeunits with pragmas
Keeps overrides for nine other rules that need broader remediation
